tests.name: Double-Charging Prevention

issues.title: Missing Idempotency Protection
issues.description: Payment endpoints lack idempotency keys, allowing potential double-charging on rapid clicks
issues.remediation:
Add idempotency_key to all payment mutations:
- Generate unique UUID for each payment request
- Store idempotency keys in Redis with TTL
- Check key exists before processing payment
- Example: idempotency_key = request.headers.get('Idempotency-Key')

issues.title: No Duplicate Request Prevention
issues.description: System lacks duplicate request detection mechanism
issues.remediation:
Implement request deduplication:
- Cache recent payment requests (Redis)
- Check customer + amount + timestamp combinations
- Use exponential backoff for retries

issues.title: Missing Rate Limiting on Payment Endpoints
issues.description: Payment endpoints may not have strict rate limiting
issues.remediation:
Add aggressive rate limiting:
- 10 requests per minute per IP for payment endpoints
- 3 requests per second per customer for charges
- Use Redis-based rate limiting

tests.name: Refund Race Condition Protection

issues.title: Refund Lacks Transaction Protection
issues.description: Refund operations not wrapped in atomic transactions
issues.remediation:
Use database transactions for refunds:
- BEGIN TRANSACTION before refund
- Lock payment record
- Check refund status
- Process refund if not already refunded
- COMMIT or ROLLBACK on error

issues.title: Missing Refund State Validation
issues.description: Refund doesn't check if payment was already refunded
issues.remediation:
Add state validation before refund:
- Check payment.refund_status
- Use enum: PENDING, REFUNDED, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED
- Store refund_id after processing
- Atomic check-and-set operation

issues.title: Refund Not Idempotent
issues.description: Multiple refund requests could process multiple times
issues.remediation:
Make refunds idempotent:
- Generate unique refund_idempotency_key
- Store in database before Stripe call
- Check key exists before refunding
- Return cached result on duplicate
